"""Original shared validation, authenticated I/O, and atomic filesystem helpers."""
import contextlib
import fcntl
import hashlib
import os
from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath
import re
import resource
import stat
import subprocess
import tarfile
import tempfile
from urllib.parse import urlsplit

from spec import BUILTIN_DEFAULTS, DEFAULTS


class Refusal(ValueError):
    pass


def require(ok, message):
    if not ok:
        raise Refusal(message)


def value(env, key):
    if key in env:
        result = env[key]
    elif key in DEFAULTS:
        result = DEFAULTS[key]
    else:
        result = BUILTIN_DEFAULTS[key]
    require(isinstance(result, str) and all(32 <= ord(c) < 127 for c in result),
            key + ': only printable ASCII, no control characters')
    return result


def switch(env, key):
    result = value(env, key)
    require(result in ('0', '1'), key + ': expected 0 or 1')
    return result == '1'


def acknowledgments(env):
    for key in ('EA_EULA_ACCEPT', 'NONCOMMERCIAL_USE'):
        require(value(env, key) == 'YES', key + '=YES is required; read the EULA first')


def regular(path, executable=False):
    st = path.lstat()
    require(stat.S_ISREG(st.st_mode) and st.st_nlink == 1 and st.st_size > 0,
            'Expected nonempty regular file (no links): ' + path.name)
    if executable:
        require(st.st_mode & 0o111, 'Missing executable permission: ' + path.name)
    return st


def digest(path):
    regular(path)
    with path.open('rb') as f:
        return hashlib.file_digest(f, 'sha256').hexdigest() if hasattr(hashlib, 'file_digest') else hash_stream(f)


def hash_stream(f):
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    for chunk in iter(lambda: f.read(1024 * 1024), b''):
        h.update(chunk)
    return h.hexdigest()


def verify(path, size, sha):
    require(regular(path).st_size == size, 'Exact byte count mismatch: ' + path.name)
    require(digest(path) == sha, 'SHA-256 mismatch: ' + path.name)


def snapshot(source, dest, size, sha):
    """Verify the private copy that will actually be consumed, never reopen input."""
    fd = os.open(source, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW | os.O_NONBLOCK)
    with os.fdopen(fd, 'rb') as src:
        before = os.fstat(src.fileno())
        require(stat.S_ISREG(before.st_mode) and before.st_nlink == 1 and before.st_size == size,
                'Uploaded archive must be a regular file with the exact byte count')
        with dest.open('xb') as out:
            left = size
            while left:
                chunk = src.read(min(left, 1024 * 1024))
                require(chunk, 'Archive changed during copy')
                out.write(chunk)
                left -= len(chunk)
            require(not src.read(1), 'Archive grew during copy')
        after = os.fstat(src.fileno())
        require((before.st_size, before.st_mtime_ns, before.st_ctime_ns) ==
                (after.st_size, after.st_mtime_ns, after.st_ctime_ns), 'Archive changed during copy')
    verify(dest, size, sha)


def https_url(url):
    require(len(url) <= 2048 and all(33 <= ord(c) < 127 for c in url), 'Invalid HTTPS URL')
    parts = urlsplit(url)
    require(parts.scheme == 'https' and parts.hostname and not parts.username and
            not parts.password and not parts.fragment, 'Only HTTPS URLs without credentials/fragments are accepted')
    return url


def download(url, dest, size, sha, direct_hub=False):
    https_url(url)
    # No cookies, netrc, curlrc, proxy credentials, HTTP redirects, or verbose URLs in errors.
    cmd = ['curl', '--disable', '--fail', '--silent', '--show-error', '--proto', '=https',
           '--proto-redir', '=https', '--connect-timeout', '30', '--max-time', '900',
           '--max-filesize', str(size), '--output', str(dest), '--url', url]
    if not direct_hub:
        cmd[2:2] = ['--location', '--max-redirs', '5']
    # Enforce a kernel write cap even with unknown/chunked Content-Length and older curl.
    def cap_file_size():
        resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_FSIZE, (size, size))

    result = subprocess.run(cmd, env={'PATH': '/usr/bin:/bin', 'LANG': 'C'},
                            stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL, timeout=930,
                            preexec_fn=cap_file_size)
    require(result.returncode == 0, 'HTTPS download failed; upload the exact archive and reinstall')
    verify(dest, size, sha)


def relative_name(name):
    require('\\' not in name and not name.startswith('/') and
            all(32 <= ord(c) < 127 for c in name), 'Unsafe archive path')
    while name.startswith('./'):
        name = name[2:]
    if name in ('', '.'):
        return ''
    path = PurePosixPath(name)
    require(all(p not in ('.', '..', '') for p in name.split('/')) and len(path.parts) <= 16 and
            len(name) <= 240, 'Unsafe archive path')
    return str(path)


def inspect_tar(tar, max_bytes=512 * 1024 * 1024, max_files=2048):
    names = set()
    total = 0
    items = []
    for member in tar:
        name = relative_name(member.name.rstrip('/'))
        require(member.isfile() or member.isdir(), 'Archive links and special files are forbidden')
        require(name.lower() not in names, 'Duplicate/case-colliding archive path')
        names.add(name.lower())
        total += member.size
        require(len(names) <= max_files and 0 <= member.size <= max_bytes and total <= max_bytes,
                'Archive exceeds extraction budget')
        items.append((member, name))
    return items


def extract_tar(path, dest, expected=None):
    with tarfile.open(path, 'r:gz') as tar:
        members = inspect_tar(tar)
        if expected is not None:
            require({n for m, n in members if m.isfile()} == set(expected), 'Unexpected archive file set')
        for member, name in members:
            if not name:
                continue
            target = dest / name
            if member.isdir():
                target.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            else:
                target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                with tar.extractfile(member) as src, target.open('xb') as out:
                    while chunk := src.read(1024 * 1024):
                        out.write(chunk)
                target.chmod(0o755 if member.mode & 0o111 else 0o644)


def tree_check(root, lowercase=False):
    require(root.is_dir() and not root.is_symlink(), 'Expected real directory')
    count = 0
    for base, dirs, files in os.walk(root, followlinks=False):
        for name in dirs + files:
            count += 1
            require(count < 100000, 'Tree exceeds entry budget')
            p = Path(base) / name
            st = p.lstat()
            require(stat.S_ISDIR(st.st_mode) or (stat.S_ISREG(st.st_mode) and st.st_nlink == 1),
                    'Tree contains link or special file')
            if lowercase and not (p.suffix == '.py' and name in files):
                require(name == name.lower(), 'Mod loose paths must be lowercase (except Python scripts)')


def atomic_write(path, content, mode=0o600):
    fd, temp = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix='.write-', dir=path.parent)
    try:
        with os.fdopen(fd, 'wb') as f:
            f.write(content)
            f.flush()
            os.fsync(f.fileno())
        os.chmod(temp, mode)
        os.replace(temp, path)
    finally:
        if os.path.exists(temp):
            os.unlink(temp)


@contextlib.contextmanager
def locked(root):
    require(root.is_dir() and not root.is_symlink(), 'Volume must be a real directory')
    fd = os.open(root / '.bf2-egg.lock', os.O_CREAT | os.O_RDWR | os.O_NOFOLLOW, 0o666)
    try:
        st = os.fstat(fd)
        require(stat.S_ISREG(st.st_mode) and st.st_nlink == 1, 'Unsafe lock file')
        # Install containers run as root while game containers run as the Wings
        # UID. The lock contains no data and must remain openable by both; the
        # server-volume directory is the access boundary.
        if stat.S_IMODE(st.st_mode) != 0o666:
            os.fchmod(fd, 0o666)
        try:
            fcntl.flock(fd, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
        except BlockingIOError as e:
            raise Refusal('Install/start already active; stop the server first') from e
        os.set_inheritable(fd, True)  # exec keeps the lock for the lifetime of the game.
        yield
    finally:
        os.close(fd)
BF2_SOURCE_COMMON_PY
cat > "$work/runtime.py" <<'BF2_SOURCE_RUNTIME_PY'
"""Validate the installed server, generate isolated configuration, then exec its launcher."""
import hashlib
import ipaddress
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import platform
import re
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
import zipfile

from common import (Refusal, acknowledgments, atomic_write, digest, locked, regular,
                    relative_name, require, switch, tree_check, value)
from spec import BASE_HASHES, HUB_HASHES


def integer(env, key, low, high):
    text = value(env, key)
    require(re.fullmatch(r'0|[1-9][0-9]{0,5}', text), key + ': expected decimal integer')
    number = int(text)
    require(low <= number <= high, key + ': outside supported range')
    return number


def token(text):
    require(re.fullmatch(r'[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_]{0,47}', text), 'Expected lowercase map/mod token')
    return text


def quoted(text):
    # The legacy console's escape grammar is not established. Refuse ambiguous input.
    require('"' not in text and '\\' not in text and all(32 <= ord(c) < 127 for c in text),
            'Quotes, backslashes and control characters are not supported')
    return '"' + text + '"'


def secret(text, rcon=False):
    if not text and not rcon:
        return text
    require((16 if rcon else 12) <= len(text) <= 64, 'Secret length outside supported range')
    folded = re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9]', '', text.lower())
    require(not any(x in folded for x in ('password', 'changeme', 'changeit', 'replace', 'example',
                                         'placeholder', 'default', 'secret', 'letmein', 'qwerty',
                                         'admin', '123456', 'yourrcon')) and len(set(text)) >= 6,
            'Refusing placeholder/weak secret')
    quoted(text)
    if rcon:
        require(re.fullmatch(r'[A-Za-z0-9._!@%+:\-]+', text), 'RCON secret contains unsupported characters')
    return text


def map_support(level):
    """Intersect advertised map types with actual gameplay data, without extracting ZIPs."""
    require(level.is_dir() and not level.is_symlink(), 'Map directory missing or unsafe')
    info = level / 'info'
    require(info.is_dir() and not info.is_symlink(), 'Map info directory missing or unsafe')
    desc = info / (level.name + '.desc')
    require(regular(desc).st_size <= 256 * 1024, 'Map metadata too large')
    data = desc.read_bytes()
    require(b'<!DOCTYPE' not in data.upper() and b'<!ENTITY' not in data.upper(), 'XML entities forbidden')
    doc = ET.fromstring(data)
    require(doc.tag == 'map', 'Unexpected map metadata root')
    declared = set()
    for mode in doc.findall('./modes/mode'):
        kind = mode.get('type')
        if kind not in ('gpm_cq', 'gpm_coop'):
            continue
        for size in mode.findall('maptype'):
            n = size.get('players')
            if n in ('16', '32', '64'):
                pair = (kind, int(n))
                require(pair not in declared, 'Duplicate map metadata combination')
                declared.add(pair)
    archive = level / 'server.zip'
    require(regular(archive).st_size <= 512 * 1024 * 1024, 'Map archive too large')
    with zipfile.ZipFile(archive) as z:
        require(len(z.infolist()) <= 50000, 'Map ZIP exceeds entry budget')
        seen = set()
        actual = set()
        for entry in z.infolist():
            name = relative_name(entry.filename.rstrip('/')).lower()
            require(name not in seen, 'Duplicate/case-colliding map ZIP entry')
            seen.add(name)
            require(not entry.flag_bits & 1 and (entry.external_attr >> 16) & 0o170000 != 0o120000,
                    'Encrypted entries and links are forbidden in map ZIP')
            m = re.fullmatch(r'gamemodes/(gpm_cq|gpm_coop)/(16|32|64)/gameplayobjects\.con', name)
            if m and entry.file_size > 0:
                actual.add((m[1], int(m[2])))
    return declared & actual


def settings(root, env):
    acknowledgments(env)
    name = value(env, 'SERVER_NAME')
    require(1 <= len(name) <= 64, 'SERVER_NAME must have 1–64 characters')
    password = secret(value(env, 'SERVER_PASSWORD'))
    mod = token(value(env, 'MOD'))
    mods = root / 'mods'
    require(mods.is_dir() and not mods.is_symlink(), 'Unsafe mods directory')
    modroot = mods / mod
    tree_check(modroot, lowercase=True)
    require((modroot / 'init.con').is_file(), 'Incomplete mod: init.con missing')
    players = integer(env, 'MAX_PLAYERS', 1, 64)
    minimum = integer(env, 'MIN_PLAYERS', 1, 64)
    bots = integer(env, 'BOT_COUNT', 0, 64)
    require(minimum <= players and bots <= players, 'Minimum players/bot count exceeds MAX_PLAYERS')
    internet = switch(env, 'INTERNET')
    hub = switch(env, 'BF2HUB_ENABLED')
    require(not hub or internet, 'BF2Hub requires INTERNET=1')
    rcon = switch(env, 'RCON_ENABLED')
    rpassword = value(env, 'RCON_PASSWORD')
    if rcon or rpassword:
        secret(rpassword, rcon=True)
    voip = switch(env, 'VOIP_ENABLED')
    ports = {k: integer(env, k, 1024, 65535) for k in
             ('SERVER_PORT', 'QUERY_PORT', 'RCON_PORT', 'VOIP_CLIENT_PORT', 'VOIP_BF_PORT', 'VOIP_SERVER_PORT')}
    active = [ports['SERVER_PORT'], ports['QUERY_PORT']]
    if rcon:
        active.append(ports['RCON_PORT'])
    if voip:
        active.extend(ports[k] for k in ('VOIP_CLIENT_PORT', 'VOIP_BF_PORT', 'VOIP_SERVER_PORT'))
    require(len(set(active)) == len(active), 'Active ports must be distinct')
    bind = str(ipaddress.IPv4Address(value(env, 'SERVER_BIND_IP')))
    rotation = value(env, 'MAP_ROTATION')
    require(0 < len(rotation) <= 4096, 'MAP_ROTATION must be nonempty, at most 4096 characters')
    lines = []
    modes = set()
    cache = {}
    for item in rotation.split(';'):
        fields = item.split()
        require(len(fields) == 3, 'Rotation entries must be: map mode size')
        level, mode, size = fields
        token(level)
        require(mode in ('gpm_cq', 'gpm_coop') and size in ('16', '32', '64'), 'Unsupported mode or size')
        if level not in cache:
            cache[level] = map_support(modroot / 'levels' / level)
        require((mode, int(size)) in cache[level], 'Map/mode/size lacks matching metadata and gameplay data')
        lines.append(f'mapList.append {level} {mode} {size}')
        modes.add(mode)
    require(not bots or 'gpm_coop' in modes, 'Bots require at least one gpm_coop map')
    entries = {
        'serverName': quoted(name), 'password': quoted(password), 'internet': int(internet),
        'serverIP': quoted(bind), 'serverPort': ports['SERVER_PORT'], 'gameSpyPort': ports['QUERY_PORT'],
        'maxPlayers': players, 'numPlayersNeededToStart': minimum,
        'roundsPerMap': integer(env, 'ROUNDS_PER_MAP', 1, 99),
        'ticketRatio': integer(env, 'TICKET_RATIO', 1, 1000), 'timeLimit': integer(env, 'TIME_LIMIT', 0, 1440),
        'coopBotCount': bots, 'coopBotRatio': integer(env, 'BOT_RATIO', 0, 100),
        'coopBotDifficulty': integer(env, 'BOT_DIFFICULTY', 10, 100),
        'punkBuster': 0, 'useGlobalRank': 0, 'useGlobalUnlocks': 0, 'allowNATNegotiation': 0,
        'voipEnabled': int(voip), 'voipServerRemote': 0,
        'voipBFClientPort': ports['VOIP_CLIENT_PORT'], 'voipBFServerPort': ports['VOIP_BF_PORT'],
        'voipServerPort': ports['VOIP_SERVER_PORT'], 'adminScript': quoted('default' if rcon else ''),
    }
    return {
        'serversettings.con': ''.join(f'sv.{k} {v}\n' for k, v in entries.items()).encode(),
        'maplist.con': ('\n'.join(lines) + '\n').encode(),
        'default.cfg': (f'port={ports["RCON_PORT"]}\npassword={rpassword if rcon else ""}\n').encode(),
    }, mod, hub


def verify_install(root, hub=False):
    require(root.is_dir() and not root.is_symlink(), 'Installed server directory missing/unsafe')
    for dirname in ('bin', 'bin/amd-64', 'admin', 'readmes', 'python', 'pb'):
        p = root / dirname
        require(p.is_dir() and not p.is_symlink(), 'Incomplete or unsafe server directory: ' + dirname)
    require(not any((root / 'pb').iterdir()) and not (root / 'pb_amd-64').exists() and
            not (root / 'pb_ia-32').exists(), 'PunkBuster is unsupported and must remain absent')
    for name, sha in BASE_HASHES.items():
        p = root / name
        regular(p, executable=True)
        require(digest(p) == sha, 'Original server file hash mismatch: ' + name)
    for name in ('readmes/eula.txt', 'readmes/readme-linux.txt', 'readmes/readmeserver.txt',
                 'pylib-2.3.4.zip', 'admin/default.py'):
        regular(root / name)
    if hub:
        for name, sha in HUB_HASHES.items():
            if '/ia-32/' in name:
                continue
            regular(root / name, executable=name.endswith(('.sh', '.so')))
            require(digest(root / name) == sha, 'BF2Hub R3 file hash mismatch: ' + name)


def runtime_preflight(root, hub):
    require(platform.machine() == 'x86_64', 'This image supports amd64 only; ia32 is not offered')
    binary = root / 'bin/amd-64/bf2'
    header = binary.read_bytes()[:20]
    require(header[:5] == b'\x7fELF\x02' and header[5] == 1 and header[18:20] == b'\x3e\x00',
            'Expected native little-endian amd64 ELF')
    env = {'PATH': '/usr/bin:/bin', 'LANG': 'C', 'LD_LIBRARY_PATH': str(root / 'bin/amd-64')}
    targets = [binary, root / 'bin/amd-64/libaidll.so', root / 'bin/amd-64/libdice_py.so']
    if hub:
        targets.append(root / 'bin/amd-64/libbf2hub.so')
    output = ''
    for target in targets:
        result = subprocess.run(['ldd', str(target)], env=env, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=20)
        require(result.returncode == 0 and 'not found' not in result.stdout + result.stderr,
                'Missing runtime dependency; use the supplied amd64 ncurses5 image')
        output += result.stdout
    match = re.search(r'libncurses\.so\.5\s+=>\s+(\S+)', output)
    require(match, 'Genuine libncurses.so.5 is required')
    actual = Path(match[1]).resolve(strict=True)
    result = subprocess.run(['readelf', '-d', str(actual)], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=20)
    require(result.returncode == 0 and '(SONAME)' in result.stdout and
            re.search(r'\(SONAME\).*\[libncurses\.so\.5\]', result.stdout),
            'Wrong ncurses ABI; symlinking ncurses6 to ncurses5 is forbidden')


def publish_config(root, files):
    """One atomic generation switch updates all three files; preserve vendor settings."""
    folder = root / 'egg-config'
    folder.mkdir(exist_ok=True, mode=0o700)
    require(not folder.is_symlink(), 'Unsafe generated config directory')
    current = folder / 'current'
    admin = root / 'admin/default.cfg'
    expected = '../egg-config/current/default.cfg'
    require(not admin.exists() and not admin.is_symlink() or
            admin.is_symlink() and os.readlink(admin) == expected, 'Operator admin/default.cfg exists; back it up explicitly first')
    old = None
    if current.exists() or current.is_symlink():
        require(current.is_symlink() and re.fullmatch(r'g-[0-9a-f]{64}', os.readlink(current)),
                'Unexpected generated configuration pointer')
        old = folder / os.readlink(current)
        require(old.is_dir() and not old.is_symlink(), 'Unsafe config generation')
        require(regular(old / 'hashes.json').st_size < 4096, 'Unsafe config manifest')
        saved = json.loads((old / 'hashes.json').read_text())
        require(set(saved) == set(files), 'Invalid generated config manifest')
        require({p.name for p in old.iterdir()} == set(files) | {'hashes.json'},
                'Previous config generation contains unexpected files; preserve for inspection')
        for name, sha in saved.items():
            require(digest(old / name) == sha, 'Generated config was edited; preserve edits before restarting')
    hashes = {k: hashlib.sha256(v).hexdigest() for k, v in files.items()}
    gen_name = 'g-' + hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(hashes, sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest()
    target = folder / gen_name
    if target.exists() or target.is_symlink():
        require(target.is_dir() and not target.is_symlink(), 'Unsafe config generation')
        require(regular(target / 'hashes.json').st_size < 4096, 'Unsafe config manifest')
        require(json.loads((target / 'hashes.json').read_text()) == hashes, 'Config manifest differs')
        for name, sha in hashes.items():
            require(digest(target / name) == sha, 'Existing config generation differs')
    else:
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='.config-', dir=folder) as tmp:
            stage = Path(tmp) / 'generation'
            stage.mkdir(mode=0o700)
            for name, content in files.items():
                atomic_write(stage / name, content)
            atomic_write(stage / 'hashes.json', json.dumps(hashes, sort_keys=True).encode())
            os.rename(stage, target)
    created_admin = False
    link = folder / '.next'
    require(not link.exists() and not link.is_symlink(), 'Stale config transaction; inspect .next')
    try:
        if not admin.is_symlink():
            admin.symlink_to(expected)
            created_admin = True
        link.symlink_to(gen_name)
        os.replace(link, current)
    except BaseException:
        if created_admin:
            admin.unlink()
        if link.is_symlink():
            link.unlink()
        raise
    # Old generations contain passwords. Keep only the active generation, after publication.
    if old is not None and old != target:
        shutil.rmtree(old)


def launch(root, env):
    acknowledgments(env)
    hub = switch(env, 'BF2HUB_ENABLED')
    verify_install(root, hub)
    files, mod, hub = settings(root, env)
    runtime_preflight(root, hub)
    publish_config(root, files)
    launch_env = dict(env)
    for key in list(launch_env):
        if key.startswith('LD_') or key in ('BASH_ENV', 'ENV', 'PYTHONPATH', 'PYTHONHOME'):
            del launch_env[key]
    launch_env.update(PATH='/usr/bin:/bin', LANG='C', TERM='xterm', HOME=str(root.parent))
    launcher = './start_bf2hub.sh' if hub else './start_original.sh'
    argv = [launcher, '+modPath', 'mods/' + mod, '+config', 'egg-config/current/serversettings.con',
            '+mapList', 'egg-config/current/maplist.con']
    os.chdir(root)
    print('BF2 preflight passed; launching original amd64 server. Readiness is unverified.', flush=True)
    os.execve(launcher, argv, launch_env)


def main():
    root = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
    with locked(root.parent):
        launch(root, os.environ)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    try:
        main()
    except (Refusal, OSError, ValueError, ET.ParseError, zipfile.BadZipFile, subprocess.SubprocessError) as e:
        print('BF2 startup refused: ' + str(e), file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)

"""Exact-hash archive installation; never run license.sh or modify a live installation."""
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import tarfile
import tempfile
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
import zipfile

from common import (Refusal, acknowledgments, digest, download, extract_tar, inspect_tar,
                    locked, regular, require, snapshot, switch, tree_check, value)
from runtime import settings, verify_install
from spec import (ARCHIVE, ARCHIVE_SIZE, ARCHIVE_SHA256, INNER, INNER_SIZE, PAYLOAD_OFFSET,
                  MIRROR, HUB_ARCHIVE, HUB_URL, HUB_SIZE, HUB_SHA256, HUB_HASHES)


def acquire(root, stage, env, hub=False):
    name, size, sha = (HUB_ARCHIVE, HUB_SIZE, HUB_SHA256) if hub else (ARCHIVE, ARCHIVE_SIZE, ARCHIVE_SHA256)
    source = root / name
    dest = stage / name
    if source.exists() or source.is_symlink():
        snapshot(source, dest, size, sha)
        return dest
    if hub:
        download(HUB_URL, dest, size, sha, direct_hub=True)
    else:
        url = value(env, 'ARCHIVE_URL')
        if not url:
            require(switch(env, 'ALLOW_THIRD_PARTY_MIRROR'),
                    'Upload ' + ARCHIVE + ' to the volume root, set ARCHIVE_URL, or explicitly enable the third-party mirror')
            print('Using optional THIRD-PARTY community HTTPS mirror; not an EA origin.', flush=True)
            url = MIRROR
        download(url, dest, size, sha)
    return dest


def unpack(archive, stage):
    outer = stage / 'outer'
    outer.mkdir()
    extract_tar(archive, outer, expected={INNER})
    script = outer / INNER
    require(regular(script).st_size == INNER_SIZE, 'Unexpected makeself installer size')
    # Inspect authenticated embedded tar BEFORE the legacy extractor sees it.
    with script.open('rb') as f:
        for _ in range(375):
            f.readline()
        require(f.tell() == PAYLOAD_OFFSET, 'Unexpected makeself header boundary')
        with tarfile.open(fileobj=f, mode='r|gz') as tar:
            inspect_tar(tar)
    payload = stage / 'payload'
    subprocess.run(['/bin/sh', str(script), '--noexec', '--nox11', '--nochown', '--target', str(payload)],
                   cwd=outer, env={'PATH': '/usr/bin:/bin', 'LANG': 'C', 'TMPDIR': str(stage)},
                   stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
                   timeout=300, check=True)
    tree_check(payload)
    return payload


def install(root, env):
    acknowledgments(env)  # Before any filesystem changes or network calls.
    hub = switch(env, 'BF2HUB_ENABLED')
    switch(env, 'ALLOW_THIRD_PARTY_MIRROR')
    require(not hub or switch(env, 'INTERNET'), 'BF2Hub requires INTERNET=1')
    with locked(root):
        destination = root / 'server'
        if destination.exists() or destination.is_symlink():
            verify_install(destination, hub)
            settings(destination, env)
            print('Existing installation verified; preserved without changes. See reinstall documentation.')
            return
        require(shutil.disk_usage(root).free >= 2 * 1024**3, 'At least 2 GiB free staging space is required')
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='.bf2-install-', dir=root) as tmp:
            stage = Path(tmp)
            archive = acquire(root, stage, env)
            payload = unpack(archive, stage)
            for name in ('pb_amd-64', 'pb_ia-32', 'bin/ia-32'):
                path = payload / name
                if path.exists():
                    shutil.rmtree(path)
            # Keep EULA/readmes; never run or ship an acceptance wrapper as a startup path.
            (payload / 'license.sh').unlink()
            (payload / 'pb').mkdir()
            shutil.copyfile(payload / 'start.sh', payload / 'start_original.sh')
            (payload / 'start_original.sh').chmod(0o755)
            if hub:
                hubarchive = acquire(root, stage, env, hub=True)
                overlay = stage / 'hub'
                overlay.mkdir()
                extract_tar(hubarchive, overlay, expected=HUB_HASHES)
                for name, sha in HUB_HASHES.items():
                    require(digest(overlay / name) == sha, 'BF2Hub per-file hash mismatch')
                    if '/ia-32/' not in name:
                        target = payload / name
                        require(not target.exists(), 'BF2Hub overlay would overwrite a file')
                        shutil.copyfile(overlay / name, target)
                        target.chmod(0o755 if name.endswith(('.sh', '.so')) else 0o644)
            code = payload / 'egg'
            code.mkdir()
            for name in ('common.py', 'spec.py', 'runtime.py', 'start.sh'):
                shutil.copyfile(Path(__file__).parent / name, code / name)
                (code / name).chmod(0o755 if name.endswith('.sh') else 0o644)
            verify_install(payload, hub)
            settings(payload, env)  # Validate all operator config before committing anything.
            require(not destination.exists() and not destination.is_symlink(), 'Destination appeared during installation')
            os.rename(payload, destination)  # Same filesystem, whole server published atomically.
        print('BF2 installation complete. EULA/readmes retained in server/readmes. Runtime acceptance still required.')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    try:
        install(Path(os.environ.get('BF2_ROOT', '/mnt/server')), os.environ)
    except (Refusal, OSError, ValueError, tarfile.TarError, ET.ParseError, zipfile.BadZipFile, subprocess.SubprocessError) as e:
        print('BF2 install refused: ' + str(e), file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)

variables.name: Ea Eula Accept
variables.description: Set exactly YES only after reading and accepting the EA Tools EULA; no automatic acceptance.

variables.name: Noncommercial Use
variables.description: Set exactly YES to acknowledge personal noncommercial use under the supplied license.

variables.name: Allow Third Party Mirror
variables.description: 1 = allow the optional community HTTPS mirror after local upload and explicit URL; 0 = no mirror. Not an EA origin.

variables.name: Archive Url
variables.description: Optional operator HTTPS source for the exact pinned archive. Local root upload takes priority. HTTPS redirects only; no embedded credentials.

variables.name: Bf2Hub Enabled
variables.description: 1 = use verified BF2Hub unranked R3; 0 = original launcher. Set before install. Requires patched clients; public listing/join unverified.

variables.name: Server Name
variables.description: Server display name, 1–64 printable ASCII characters; quotes and backslashes are refused.

variables.name: Server Password
variables.description: Empty = public join; otherwise 12–64 printable ASCII characters without quotes/backslashes. Placeholder secrets are refused.

variables.name: Internet
variables.description: 1 = Internet reporting; 0 = offline/private. BF2Hub requires 1. Does not configure firewall/NAT.

variables.name: Server Bind Ip
variables.description: Local IPv4 bind address; 0.0.0.0 listens on container interfaces. Never put an unbound public NAT address here.

variables.name: Query Port
variables.description: GameSpy query/status UDP; separate allocation required for BF2Hub reachability.

variables.name: Max Players
variables.description: Player slots, 1–64 supported by this candidate. Map size is selected separately in each rotation entry.

variables.name: Min Players
variables.description: Players required to start; must not exceed MAX_PLAYERS.

variables.name: Rounds Per Map
variables.description: Rounds before rotating, candidate policy 1–99.

variables.name: Ticket Ratio
variables.description: Ticket percentage, candidate policy 1–1000 percent; higher values lengthen rounds.

variables.name: Time Limit
variables.description: Round limit in minutes; 0 = no limit, candidate policy up to 1440.

variables.name: Bot Count
variables.description: Coop bots, 0–64 and no greater than MAX_PLAYERS; positive count requires a gpm_coop rotation.

variables.name: Bot Ratio
variables.description: Coop team bot ratio in percent, 0–100.

variables.name: Bot Difficulty
variables.description: Coop difficulty: 10 = easiest, 100 = hardest; requires cooperative map data.

variables.name: Mod
variables.description: Lowercase mod directory token: letters/digits/underscores; starts with a letter or digit. xpack/custom content must be supplied separately.

variables.name: Map Rotation
variables.description: Semicolon-separated map mode size triples. Modes gpm_cq/gpm_coop, sizes 16/32/64; every combination must exist in installed metadata and server.zip.

variables.name: Rcon Enabled
variables.description: 1 = authenticated TCP RCON using default admin module; 0 = no admin module/listener. Restrict source IPs in your firewall.

variables.name: Rcon Port
variables.description: Optional RCON TCP allocation; only used when RCON_ENABLED=1.

variables.name: Rcon Password
variables.description: Required when RCON is enabled: 16–64 ASCII letters/digits or ._!@%+:-; no spaces or equals sign. Placeholder secrets refused.

variables.name: Voip Enabled
variables.description: 1 = integrated VOIP, requiring three extra UDP allocations; 0 = disabled. Listener behavior remains unverified.

variables.name: Voip Client Port
variables.description: Integrated VOIP client UDP port; used only with VOIP_ENABLED=1.

variables.name: Voip Bf Port
variables.description: Integrated VOIP BF server UDP port; used only with VOIP_ENABLED=1.

variables.name: Voip Server Port
variables.description: Integrated VOIP server UDP port; used only with VOIP_ENABLED=1.
